title: 第五章 奶爸上位第六章 一家三口
content_zh:
秦雪带着林昆乘坐专人电梯，直接来到了楚相国的办公室外，林昆一个人进了办公室，秦雪留候在外面，一进到楚相国的大办公室里，林昆顿时眼前一亮，真不敢想象一间办公室能如此的宽大豪华，就这一间房子就比老胡的整个小二楼气派多了。
“小林呐，随便坐，不要拘束。”楚相国笑着招呼道，亲自给林昆倒了一杯茶。
“好的，谢谢楚董。”林昆笑着接过茶杯，坐在了楚相国对面的沙发上，屁股刚一着地，顿时一阵柔软舒服的感觉，就好像坐在女人的肚皮上。
“小林，你看你，刚说了不要拘束，你这就跟我客气上了，什么楚董啊，叫我楚叔就好。”楚相国笑着道：“尝尝这茶，上等的武夷山大红袍。”
“好的楚叔，那我就不拘束，也不客气了。”林昆笑着道，端起茶杯小抿了一口茶，他根本不懂得喝茶，但这茶入口的口感确实说不出的好，一看楚相国就是拿出了真心实意，这让林昆很欣慰，真正的有钱人看待茶叶可是比香烟和名酒都要贵重，香烟和名酒归根到底都会伤身，但茶叶不同。
“怎么样？”楚相国笑着问。
“嗯……”
林昆放下了茶杯，吧唧了一下嘴，笑着道：“说真的楚叔，我不懂得喝茶，但这茶喝在嘴里的感觉确实说不出的好，一看就是茶中的极品。”
“哈哈，你还挺会喝的嘛。”楚相国爽朗的笑了两声，道：“那我们谈谈正事？”
林昆笑着道：“楚叔你说。”
楚相国道：“老胡让你来中港市找我，是想让我给你安排个工作，我这个正好有个工作，月薪三万，工作时间自由，而且不需要费什么体力，你愿意考虑下么？”
“三万！？”
林昆惊讶的道，本来以为月薪一万就够多了，这一下子变成了三万，由不得他不惊讶，看来不应该回去炸老胡的小二楼，而是得好好的感谢他啊。
楚相国笑了一下，道：“要不也别三万了，干脆五万得了，怎么样小林，你愿意考虑下么？”
“五万……”
林昆更惊讶了，同时看向楚相国的眼神里多少有些不确定，这一进门又是不客气又是茶水的，还出了这么高的工资，该不会是有什么阴谋吧？
楚相国看出了林昆心里的蛛丝马迹，笑着道：“这工作其实是……”
林昆立马打起了精神，他一直就对这神秘的工作好奇，现在谜底终于要揭开了。
楚相国像是故意要吊林昆的胃口，故意停顿了一下，端起茶杯抿了一口茶水，然后继续道：“这工作有些特殊，是给我五岁的小外孙当爸爸。”
楚相国话音刚落，尤其最后的三个字‘当爸爸’，林昆差点从沙发上摔下来，这工作实在太奇葩、太超乎想象了，他一时半会儿也接受不了，纵使他之前想破了脑袋，也想不出这么一个奇葩的工作，还不如当保安容易接受些，兵王当保安怎么也算是和本行沾点边，兵王当奶爸那可真是普天之下独树一帜，天南盼海北，一辈子也挨不着个边儿。

“小林呐，你先别这么大的反应，这只是一份工作，你不要太有负担，我的小外孙很可爱的，我保证你会喜欢上这孩子，喏，这是他的照片。”
楚相国从兜里掏出照片递给林昆，林昆眼神缓缓的挪到了照片上，照片上澄澄站在海边，摆出一个非常可爱的造型，脸上的笑容十分灿烂。
这确实是一个很可爱的孩子，可他跟自己没啥关系啊，不行，还是无法说服自己当这个奶爸，除非……
楚相国认真的观察者林昆脸上的表情，道：“小林，工资我再给你加两万，月薪七万！”
林昆蹙着眉头，还是一副很纠结的表情。
这件事今天晚上必须敲定，否则明天早晨就无法跟澄澄交代了，楚相国干脆一咬牙，使出了杀手锏，掏出兜里的另一张照片递到林昆面前，道：“这是我女儿楚静瑶，澄澄的妈妈。”
林昆紧蹙的眉头唰的一下开了，瞳孔跟着颤了一颤，照片上楚静瑶一头长发，精致的蚕眉下一双狭长的丹凤眼，透露出一阵温柔而又妖娆的目光，鼻梁白皙挺拔，樱红的两瓣薄唇噙着一丝直入人心的微笑……
美，简直是太美了！本来纠结的心里，马上就有了主意，就算不冲那月薪七万，也不冲那可爱的小男孩，就冲这孩子他妈，这笔买卖也非做不可了！
林昆表面上还是故意矜持了一下，恢复了之前的纠结表情，道：“楚叔，这孩子确实挺可爱的，而且孩子他妈一个人带孩子肯定也不容易，我作为一个男人有义务去照顾、保护女人和孩子，这工作我应了。”
这一套冠冕堂皇的话说完，不说楚相国有什么反应，林昆他自己都脸红了。
content_en:
Qin Xue took Lin Kun in the dedicated elevator and went directly to the outside of Chu Xiangguo's office. Lin Kun entered the office alone, while Qin Xue waited outside. As soon as he entered Chu Xiangguo's large office, Lin Kun's eyes suddenly lit up. He couldn't imagine that an office could be so spacious and luxurious. This room alone was much more grand than the entire second floor of Lao Hu's house.
"Xiao Lin, sit down wherever you want, don't be restrained." Chu Xiangguo greeted with a smile and poured a cup of tea for Lin Kun himself.
"Okay, thank you, Director Chu." Lin Kun took the tea cup with a smile and sat on the sofa opposite Chu Xiangguo. As soon as his butt touched the ground, he suddenly felt a soft and comfortable feeling, as if he was sitting on a woman's belly.
"Xiao Lin, look at you, I just told you not to be restrained, and now you are being polite to me. You are not Director Chu, just call me Uncle Chu." Chu Xiangguo said with a smile: "Try this tea, the best Wuyishan Dahongpao."
"Okay, Uncle Chu, then I won't be restrained or polite." Lin Kun said with a smile, picked up the teacup and took a sip of tea. He didn't know how to drink tea at all, but the taste of this tea was indeed indescribable. Seeing that Chu Xiangguo showed his sincerity, Lin Kun was very pleased. Really rich people regard tea as more valuable than cigarettes and famous wines. In the end, cigarettes and famous wines are both harmful to the body, but tea is different.
"How is it?" Chu Xiangguo asked with a smile.
"Well..."
Lin Kun put down the tea cup, smacked his lips, and said with a smile: "To be honest, Uncle Chu, I don't know how to drink tea, but the feeling of drinking this tea in my mouth is indeed indescribable. It is the best tea at first glance."
"Haha, you are quite good at drinking." Chu Xiangguo laughed heartily twice and said, "Then let's talk about business?"
Lin Kun smiled and said, "Uncle Chu, tell me."
Chu Xiangguo said: "Lao Hu asked you to come to Zhonggang City to find me because he wanted me to arrange a job for you. I happen to have a job with a monthly salary of 30,000 yuan, free working hours, and no physical exertion. Are you willing to consider it?"
"Thirty thousand!?"
Lin Kun said in surprise. He originally thought that a monthly salary of 10,000 yuan was enough, but now it suddenly became 30,000 yuan. He couldn't help but be surprised. It seemed that he should not go back to blow up Lao Hu's small second floor, but should thank him properly.
Chu Xiangguo smiled and said: "Why don't you give up 30,000 yuan? Let's just get 50,000 yuan. What about Xiaolin, are you willing to consider it?"
"Fifty thousand..."
Lin Kun was even more surprised. At the same time, he looked at Chu Xiangguo with a somewhat uncertain look in his eyes. He was so rude when he came in and asked for tea, and he was offered such a high salary. Could there be some conspiracy?
Chu Xiangguo saw the clues in Lin Kun's heart and said with a smile: "This job is actually..."
Lin Kun immediately cheered up. He had always been curious about this mysterious job, and now the answer was finally revealed.
Chu Xiangguo seemed to be deliberately trying to whet Lin Kun's appetite. He paused deliberately, picked up the tea cup and took a sip of tea, and then continued: "This job is a bit special. It is to be the father of my five-year-old grandson."
As soon as Chu Xiangguo finished speaking, especially the last three words 'to be a father', Lin Kun almost fell off the sofa. This job was so weird and beyond imagination that he couldn't accept it for a while. Even if he thought about it before, he still wanted to If you don't get such a weird job, it would be easier to accept it than being a security guard. Being a security guard as a soldier king is still a little bit related to the industry. Being a nanny as a soldier king is really unique in the world. You can't be close to each other in your life.
"Xiao Lin, please don't have such a big reaction. This is just a job. Don't be too burdened. My little grandson is very cute. I guarantee you will like this child. Here, here is his photo."
Chu Xiangguo took out the photo from his pocket and handed it to Lin Kun. Lin Kun's eyes slowly moved to the photo. In the photo, Chengcheng was standing on the beach, posing in a very cute pose, with a bright smile on his face..
This is indeed a very cute child, but he has nothing to do with me. No, I still can't convince myself to be this dad unless...
Chu Xiangguo carefully observed the expression on Lin Kun's face and said, "Xiao Lin, I will add another 20,000 yuan to your salary, and the monthly salary is 70,000 yuan!"
Lin Kun frowned, still looking very confused.
This matter must be finalized tonight, otherwise he will not be able to explain it to Chengcheng tomorrow morning. Chu Xiangguo simply gritted his teeth and used his trump card. He took out another photo from his pocket and handed it to Lin Kun and said, "This is my daughter Chu Jingyao, Chengcheng's mother."
Lin Kun's frown suddenly opened, and his pupils trembled. In the photo, Chu Jingyao had long hair, and a pair of narrow red phoenix eyes under delicate silk eyebrows, revealing a gentle and enchanting gaze. The bridge of her nose was white and straight, and her thin cherry red lips held a smile that penetrated people's hearts...
Beautiful, simply so beautiful! I was originally troubled, but I immediately came up with an idea. Even if it wasn't for the monthly salary of 70,000 yuan, or for the cute little boy, it was for this child's mother. This deal had to be done!
On the surface, Lin Kun was still deliberately reserved, regaining his previous troubled expression, and said: "Uncle Chu, this child is indeed very cute, and it is definitely not easy for the mother to raise the child alone. As a man, I have the obligation to take care of and protect women and children, and I accept this job."
After saying these high-sounding words, not to mention Chu Xiangguo's reaction, Lin Kun himself blushed.
